articles.headline: Alcaraz advances to Tokyo semifinals after Shapovalov injury
articles.description: Carlos Alcaraz moved into the final four at the Tokyo Open after his quarterfinal opponent, Denis Shapovalov, was forced to retire due to a hip injury.

articles.headline: Sinner extends absence by withdrawing from Shanghai Masters
articles.description: Top-ranked Jannik Sinner has withdrawn from the Shanghai Masters as he deals with a knee problem.

articles.headline: Alcaraz beats Arnaldi to reach 3rd round at Japan Open
articles.description: Top-seeded Carlos Alcaraz beat Matteo Arnaldi 7-6 (6), 6-1 on Saturday in a second-round match at the Japan Open, continuing his strong return to play after a four-month layoff due to a wrist injury.

articles.headline: Novak Djokovic rallies, improves to 31-0 at China Open

articles.headline: Indian tennis player Somani suspended 4 years in doping case
articles.description: Indian tennis player Parikshit Somani was banned for four years in a doping case Wednesday after judges dismissed an explanation he gave that was similar to the case of Russian figure skater Kamila Valieva.
